SourceProxy.name: DistributePoints
SourceProxy.label: Distribute Points

Documentation.long_help: Fairly distribute points over processors into spatially contiguous regions.

SourceProxy.Documentation: This filter fairly distributes points over processors into contiguous spatial regions. The output is a PolyData which does not contain any cell. Distribution is done using a Kd-tree.
